d: ZAD is the brainchild of a group of young, passionate Kuwaiti financial professionals driven by a vision of fostering a culture of investment in Kuwait. And for this team, Zad began as a means to answer a need in the market: the need to make investment an accessible concept and viable choice for a broader audience
r: This is a full-time, on-site Call Center role for a Client Relations Officer at Zad in the Kuwait City Metropolitan Area. The Client Relations Officer will be responsible for managing client relationships, handling inbound and outbound calls, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring customer satisfaction through effective communication and service delivery.
Working Hours: 8 hours per day, rotating shifts (Only morning shift for females)
Language: A local accent is required for effective communication with clients
ZAD supports growth and high potential team members. We will provide support to talented and ambitious team members to achieve their career goals.
